figures.label: p2
figures.caption: Main p.1311 'Variability of cell assembly conditions': stepwise uniaxial compression; average cycling pressure mostly 10–70 MPa; positive-composite compression 250–520 MPa; compression durations differ by orders of magnitude; >300 MPa and hours needed to densify thiophosphate SEs [13,14]; NMC (secondary) particles prone to breaking at such pressures [15].

figures.label: p5
figures.caption: Main p.1314: best performers = >120 mAh g−1 after 50 cycles (12 cells: B1–B3, H1–H2, K2, O1–O3, Q1, S1–S2; OCV >2.5 V, initial ΔV 0.10–0.25 V, retention >85 %); commonalities: R0 18–42 Ω cm2 (separator pressed 'hand-pressing' to 590 MPa), separator+composite compressed 300–590 MPa for 1–5 min, whole-cell compression mostly not done, cycling >40 MPa (bias, not application-transferable); reproducible composite preparation decisive.

figures.label: p6
